## f65705efd235

**Reproduced distribution defect — the declared rectangle grammar excludes a
lawful canonical branch.** The generator samples `r2 >= r1 + 2` and
`c2 >= c1 + 2`, so every generated rectangle is at least 3x3. Canonical
`train[3]`, however, contains color 2 at `(1,7)`, `(1,8)`, `(5,7)`, and
`(5,8)`: a 5x2 rectangle. Its visible input/output are:

```text
input                 output
000000000             000000000
000000022             000000022
006000600             006666622
000000000             006000622
000000000             006000622
000000022             006000622
006000600             006666600
000000000             000000000
```

A learner trained only on this generator can therefore adopt the shortcut
“valid corner rectangles always have an empty interior row and an empty
interior column” (equivalently, both bbox dimensions are at least 3). Every
generated positive supports it, but the canonical width-2 rectangle refutes it.
The exact parsed bbox is recorded under
`targets.f65705efd235.canonical_train_3.width_two_counterexamples` in the audit
evidence.

**Reproduced override-contract defect.** At seed `314159`, sample index `7`,
medium difficulty, the base draw has shape 12x16 and SHA-256
`bacc667cda75922eb7e13ff74e6ac0769f72be174c1950b91dac08d5a4dc125e`.
The byte-equivalent grid is returned for each of `n_rects=1`, `n_rects=8`,
`grid_h=5,grid_w=6`, `palette_kind=warm`, and the undeclared key
`unknown=123`. Thus several public axes are inert and unknown keys are silently
accepted. This is independently harmful because an override-indexed dataset can
claim controlled variation that never occurred.
